committedStage.message: perf: reutilizar classificações equivalentes dos eixos de custo

candidate: Uncommitted local continuation. No deployment, new migration/index, concurrency cap, pool change or backup work.
changes: Keep both report parent queries and their order. Collect the union of their protected IDs once; one parameterized SELECT reads nominal links with reportId = ANY(bound text[]).
Bind IDs as one array value; no string interpolation. Array payload remains proportional to selected report count, while SQL text and placeholder count remain constant.
Start the link read when the two parent promises resolve, overlapping project/interval sources. Native promises ensure each parent executes once. Empty IDs skip the link query.
Map links back into the original parent order for period cost and annual eligibility, preserving historical/tied RDOs and current financial/access rules. No new cross-request cache.

rejectedFilterPrototype.decision: Not retained: repeating parent source predicates in a direct roster union re-scanned ReportService (4802 rows in the dense fixture). The accepted typed-array query uses the already-selected IDs and avoids that repeated work.
rejectedFilterPrototype.patchScope: Profiling-only prototype; git apply --check passed against an isolated 3d4971eb archive. Not an accepted application patch.

service.method: Local paired uncached service calculations on PostgreSQL with warm database pages; not HTTP latency. Timings exclude process boot and module imports. Fresh Node/Prisma processes for every cold sample. After-session performs a SELECT, not HTTP authentication. Prisma operation profiles include mapping; sqlQueries capture pg pool calls and replay SELECTs with EXPLAIN ANALYZE after the calculation. Pool call durations overlap and include queue/event-loop delays. Initialization diagnostics run in separate processes and do not warm timed samples. Result bytes are JSON sizes, not network traffic.
service.cpuMethod: process.cpuUsage delta around the calculation only, before EXPLAIN replay; includes Node/Prisma CPU, excludes PostgreSQL, module imports and process boot. CPU and wall time are separate observations.

method.sourceParity: Eight complete normalized outputs in ten states; separate source processes on identical PostgreSQL rows. Includes role/salary/report changes, official allocations/cycles/cancellation, plan deactivation, group/manual/confirmed sharing, consolidation and changed RDO/annual rosters. 80 equal result pairs for the accepted version.
method.service: Three paired uncached calculations per mode, alternating source order, with 1203 reports, 4802 services and 21 collaborators. Nine equal result pairs per variant. SQL captures and EXPLAIN ANALYZE replays are separate extra diagnostic calls, not server-side duration of the original execution.
method.http: Four sequential cohorts per variant, control/candidate then candidate/control; 832 measured 200 responses per cohort, eight expected auth/module negatives separately. 800 warm responses (100 per route/profile), eight first-process, eight warmups and 16 after-write. Both prototype and accepted samples retained: 6656 measured responses.
method.environment: PostgreSQL 16, one CPU, 768 MiB; API pool eight, concurrency four, distributed group reports, point summary projection. No tests or other benchmarks from this task during timed runs. API host not isolated; no proxy/TLS/browser/production measured.

backendSuite.command: node --test --test-concurrency=4 test/*.test.js; dedicated PostgreSQL opt-ins disabled and run separately.

coverage: Existing period and annual parent predicates retained; parent cost-report SQL hashes match the baseline in every parity state, preserving tied RDO precedence.
One typed array parameter to one roster SELECT, only for the exact parent IDs returned by protected Prisma queries. Empty sources skip the roster read.
Historical RDOs outside the point period, annual-only offshore reports, onshore period reports, exclusive date/year limits, soft deletion, interval fallback and source non-mutation remain covered.
Changed RDO/annual links observed on the next read; failed roster reads reject the entire load. Restricted project IDs excluded from raw bindings and returned source arrays.
Omni test transport now redirects both ORM and parameterized queries to the same disposable Prisma/PostgreSQL WASM database; existing money/privacy assertions unchanged.
validation.syntax: Changed source/tests passed node --check; git diff --check passed.

acceptance.queryReduction: Period/annual nominal rosters: two reads to one. Warm point HTTP: 32 to 31; warm detail/group remain 51-52 and cards 11. Direct rate calculations remove one call; attendance and diagnosis retain their existing source paths.
acceptance.parameterGrowth: Dense baseline roster maximum 1203 placeholders; accepted query uses one typed array. Cost-parent SQL unchanged in all source parity states.
acceptance.latency: Descriptive sequential measurements do not establish uniform or causal/statistical p95 acceptance.

ci.note: 61010fcd, ae2caee9 and 3d4971eb are local commits. They and the continuation require new CI after a future push.

limitations: IDs still travel in an array proportional to the selected parents; this removes placeholder expansion, not the underlying historical evidence or row volume.
One first-process HTTP sample per route/profile cannot establish cold p95 or close general published cold acceptance; service timing excludes imports/boot and uses warm database pages.
CPU is whole-process CPU in the calculation window; query durations overlap and include pool waits. EXPLAIN replays are separate observations.
Active pool samples are interval observations, not per-query wait times. After-write timings start after commit and measurement preparation; cards retain normal expiry.
Published HTTP/useful-content/LCP, two-browser coverage, 24-hour/seven-day operation and retention policy remain pending. Backups deferred by user.
